sn35.19:1.1: “Bhikkhus, one who seeks delight in the eye seeks delight in suffering.
sn35.19:1.2: One who seeks delight in suffering, I say, is not freed from suffering.
sn35.19:1.3: One who seeks delight in the ear …
sn35.19:1.8: in the mind seeks delight in suffering.
sn35.19:1.9: One who seeks delight in suffering, I say, is not freed from suffering.
sn35.19:2.1: “One who does not seek delight in the eye …
sn35.19:2.8: in the mind does not seek delight in suffering.
sn35.19:2.9: One who does not seek delight in suffering, I say, is freed from suffering.”
